title: Recent advances and design strategies for organic afterglow agents to enhance autofluorescence-free imaging performance
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01060D, Review Article
Jieli Zhu, Liangyou Zhao, Weihao An, Qingqing Miao
Organic afterglow luminescence can emit light long after the cessation of irradiation, enabling autofluorescence-free in vivo imaging with high signal-to-background ratios (SBRs).
